column1: # Remote ATV 6.1.0 build 45; optional page-swipe patch after ad-free/status restoration.
# Fields: input SHA-256 / output SHA-256, then file offset / expected bytes / replacement bytes.
# Constructor marks only the two remote PageViews via pageSnapping=false.
# Physics hook tail-calls existing NeverScrollableScrollPhysics.applyTo for those views.
# Tail branches preserve original GC safepoints and allocation sizes; setup paging is unchanged.
# Caller checks use PC-relative differences, so library load alignment does not affect them.
